# Selke Pest Control

> Selke Pest Control is a family-owned pest control company based in Mooresville, North Carolina, serving Lake Norman and the Charlotte Metro area.

Selke Pest Control provides general household pest control, mosquito control, flea and tick control, ant control, cockroach control, spider control, stinging-insect control, and mice and rodent control. Service is backed by a 100% satisfaction guarantee. Same-week appointments are available in many cases.

## Primary facts

- Business: Selke Pest Control
